ch17-open.title: Images
ch17-open.standfirst: Drop an image onto the canvas like any element — the simplest thing you can bring into a meeting.

c17-images.heading: Add an image to the canvas
c17-images.lead: An image — a photo, a screenshot, an exported render — goes onto the canvas the same way as any file: drag it straight onto the board, or upload it to the room library and click to place it. Canvas M accepts standard picture formats (PNG, JPG and the like).
c17-images.body: Once placed, an image is a normal canvas element: move, resize, lock it, or draw and stamp on top. To brand an image with a stamp so the mark stays attached, see Stickers & stamps.
